title: German Gazpacho Soup
description: A refreshing twist on the Spanish classic, made with hearty German ingredients. This cold soup is perfect for hot summer days.
instructions: Peel and chop the cucumber, red bell pepper, and red onion.
In a blender or food processor, puree the tomatoes, bread, vinegar, garlic, salt, and black pepper until smooth.
Add the chopped cucumber, red bell pepper, and red onion to the blender.
Blend until the mixture is well combined and the vegetables are finely chopped.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve chilled, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
